nginx: the configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf syntax is ok
nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test is successful
# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
user www-data;
worker_processes auto;
pid /run/nginx.pid;
error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log;
include /etc/nginx/modules-enabled/*.conf;

events {
	worker_connections 768;
	# multi_accept on;
}

http {

	##
	# Basic Settings
	##

	sendfile on;
	tcp_nopush on;
	types_hash_max_size 2048;
	# server_tokens off;

	include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
	default_type application/octet-stream;

	##
	# SSL Settings
	##

	ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; # Dropping SSLv3, ref: POODLE
	ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;

	##
	# Logging Settings
	##

	access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log;

	gzip on;

	##
	# Virtual Host Configs
	##

	include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
	include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/*;
}

stream {
	server {
		listen 8883 ssl;
		ssl_certificate /etc/ssl/mqtt/mqtt.pem;
		ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/mqtt/mqtt.key;
		proxy_pass 127.0.0.1:1883;
	}
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/modules-enabled/50-mod-stream.conf:
load_module modules/ngx_stream_module.so;

# configuration file /etc/nginx/mime.types:

types {
    text/html                                        html htm shtml;
    text/css                                         css;
    application/javascript                           js;
    image/png                                        png;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/default-tls.conf:
# Answers names no other server serves, with a certificate of its own.
server {
	listen 443 ssl default_server;
	listen [::]:443 ssl default_server;
	server_name _;
	ssl_certificate /etc/ssl/fallback/fallback.pem;
	ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/fallback/fallback.key;
	return 444;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/api.example:
server {
	listen 8443 ssl;
	server_name api.shop.example;
	include /etc/nginx/snippets/acme-tls.conf;

	location /hello {
		default_type text/plain;
		content_by_lua_block {
			-- braces in Lua strings and comments are not nginx's: }
			ngx.say("{ hello; }")
			local t = { [[ } ]], '}' }
		}
	}
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/snippets/acme-tls.conf:
ssl_certificate /etc/ssl/acme/fullchain.pem;
ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/acme/privkey.pem;
ssl_session_timeout 1d;
ssl_session_cache shared:MozSSL:10m;

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/app.example.test:
server {
	listen 443 ssl;
	server_name app.example.test ~^(?<t>.+)\.app\.example\.test$;
	ssl_certificate /etc/ssl/app/fullchain.pem;
	ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/app/privkey.pem;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/blog.example:
server {
	root /var/www/blog;
	index index.html;
	server_name blog.example;

	location / {
		try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
	}

	listen [::]:443 ssl ipv6only=on; # managed by Certbot
	listen 443 ssl; # managed by Certbot
	ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/blog.example/fullchain.pem; # managed by Certbot
	ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/blog.example/privkey.pem; # managed by Certbot
	include /etc/letsencrypt/options-ssl-nginx.conf; # managed by Certbot
	ssl_dhparam /etc/letsencrypt/ssl-dhparams.pem; # managed by Certbot
}

server {
	if ($host = blog.example) {
		return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
	} # managed by Certbot

	listen 80;
	listen [::]:80;
	server_name blog.example;
	return 404; # managed by Certbot
}

# configuration file /etc/letsencrypt/options-ssl-nginx.conf:
# This file contains important security parameters. If you modify this file
# manually, Certbot will be unable to automatically provide future security
# updates. Instead, Certbot will print and log an error message with a path to
# the up-to-date file that you will need to refer to when manually updating
# this file. Contents are based on https://ssl-config.mozilla.org

ssl_session_cache shared:le_nginx_SSL:10m;
ssl_session_timeout 1440m;
ssl_session_tickets off;

ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;

ssl_ciphers "ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384";

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/legacy.example:
server {
	listen 80;
	listen [::]:80;
	server_name legacy.example ~^(?<sub>.+)\.legacy\.example$;
	root /var/www/legacy;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/old.example:
server {
	listen 443 ssl;
	server_name old.example www.old.example;
	ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/old.example/fullchain.pem;
	ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/old.example/privkey.pem;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/shop.example:
server {
	listen 80;
	listen [::]:80;
	server_name shop.example www.shop.example;
	return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}

server {
	listen 443 ssl;
	listen [::]:443 ssl;
	http2 on;
	server_name shop.example www.shop.example;
	include snippets/acme-tls.conf;

	location / {
		proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080;
		proxy_set_header Host $host;
		proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto "https";
	}
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/tenants.example:
server {
	listen 443 ssl;
	server_name .tenants.example;
	ssl_certificate /etc/ssl/tenants/$ssl_server_name.crt;
	ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/tenants/$ssl_server_name.key;
}
